property_summary: For any depositor and any admissible amount, a successful Put must append a History entry to the Log whose Sender is that depositor and whose Val equals the deposited amount; the mutant removes AddMessage from Put, so no such entry is ever recorded (History(0) is absent or wrong) for some fuzzed input.
change_summary: Remove the LogFile.AddMessage call so deposits are no longer recorded in the log.
